name: Validate supported SSSOM
command:
uv run --frozen python - <<'PY'
from sssom.parsers import parse_sssom_table
from sssom.validators import SchemaValidationType, validate
validate(parse_sssom_table("output/mim-kgx-710-supported/ingredient_mappings.sssom.tsv"),
         validation_types=[SchemaValidationType.JsonSchema,
                           SchemaValidationType.PrefixMapCompleteness,
                           SchemaValidationType.StrictCurieFormat])
PY
